text: FLEX droplets in CO2-diluted air: 88/123 tests ended in flame extinction.
FLEX droplets in He-diluted air: 40/50 tests ended in flame extinction.
FLEX droplets in N2-diluted air: 58/101 tests ended in flame extinction.
Liquid droplets sustained a flame down to 12% O2 in microgravity.
BASS-II solids were burned while O2 was bled down to 13.5% - well below Earth air.
CFI-G pushed oxidizer to 85% O2; 263 of 333 attempts produced a hot flame.
Saffire-II: 2 silicone samples burned completely in the 1-g test yet did not spread in microgravity at 20 cm/s - 1-g screening is not always the worst case.
SPICE logged 435 jet-flame points across 7 fuels to map when flames start shedding smoke.
